name: Thermal Boundary Plausibility
applicable_contexts: insulation system age, type or condition unresolved
trigger_conditions: thermal bridging at floor/wall/roof joints unresolved
physical_basis: Envelope conductance, vapor barrier integrity and thermal bridging set the floor of refrigeration duty. Degradation accumulates silently.
operational_basis: Vapor migration causes insulation to wet and lose R-value; thermal bridges at structural connections form persistent loss paths.
financial_mechanism: Envelope interventions are capital-grade, long-lived, and outrank equipment retrofits when conductance is degraded.
typical_false_assumption: Envelope is fine because it looks fine.
hypothesis: Thermal boundary integrity may be degraded and should be falsified before refrigeration CAPEX logic.
minimum_evidence_to_confirm: thermal imaging or moisture survey shows degradation
falsification_conditions: recent commissioning or audit confirms envelope integrity
allowed_claim_language: Thermal boundary degradation is a plausible loss-pattern requiring envelope evidence.
financial_exposure_if_true: envelope CAPEX may outrank refrigeration replacement
escalation_conditions: thermal imaging survey if no documentary evidence
example_outputs: Thermal boundary integrity should be falsified before refrigeration retrofits.
tests: cold_chain bundle should activate this when envelope evidence missing
